title: sys_idp_group_mapping: a mapping that matches no current group cannot be shown as such
body:
repo:cloud#3 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZqfEd7pcckjz3pGqn

Blocks cloud#4278 (p2, SCIM provisioning console); drafted by the cloud#4278 card thread (session_01JQwxbY3zqaaaSj7tJsov3a) and filed by the seat.

Edition / version: framework pin 99992ddf. Consumer: cloud SCIM provisioning console "Group mappings" grid; cloud#4278 item 4.

Measured on cloud#4278: a mapping by `groupDisplayName` ("ObjectOS SCIM Test" → `ai_ledger_member_read`); Okta renames the group (`PATCH /Groups/:id` `replace displayName`); every member loses the grant at once (fail-closed, correct). The mapping row is unchanged and nothing on it says it now matches nothing. Renaming back restores the grant.

Why (code): the matcher (`plugin-auth/src/scim-group-projection.ts`, `roles.map`) compares the mapping's `group_external_id` / `group_display_name` with the pushed group on each mutation and stores nothing about the result. `sys_idp_group_mapping` has no match field. `sys_scim_group` (the pushed groups) carries `defaultRowScope: id == null`, so a page cannot list the groups beside the mappings for an admin to compare. A page cannot compute "no group matches" declaratively (no anti-join in a list view).

Seam: `runtime: scim-group-projection roles.map` → `object: sys_idp_group_mapping` (no consumer field yet).

Expected: the mapping row says whether it matches a current group of its source, e.g. `matched_group_id` + `matched_at` maintained by the projection and by the group create / rename / delete path (SCIM mappings; an SSO mapping has no stored group list and reads "not applicable"), so a console can show "matches no current group". A test: rename the group → the mapping reads unmatched; rename back → matched.

Dedupe words: "group mapping unmatched", "idp group rename revokes", "sys_idp_group_mapping matched", "scim group mapping stale".
